```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from rlberry.envs.bandits import BernoulliBandit
from rlberry.agents.bandits import (
    UCB,
    UCBV,
    ETC,
    MOSS,
    IMED,
    NPTS,
    EXP3
)
from rlberry.wrappers import WriterWrapper
from rlberry.manager import ExperimentManager

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Problem parameters
n_arms = 5
means = [0.1, 0.5, 0.3, 0.8, 0.6]
T = 1000  # Horizon
n_fit = 1  # Number of fits per agent

# Create bandit environment
env_ctor = BernoulliBandit
env_kwargs = dict(p=means)

# Define agent classes and their parameters
agent_classes = [
    ("UCB", UCB, {}),
    ("UCBV", UCBV, {}),
    ("ETC", ETC, {"horizon": T}),
    ("MOSS", MOSS, {}),
    ("IMED", IMED, {}),
    ("NPTS", NPTS, {"n_particles": 100}),
    ("EXP3", EXP3, {"gamma": 0.07}),
]

# Create ExperimentManagers for each agent
managers = []
for name, agent_cls, agent_kwargs in agent_classes:
    agent_kwargs = agent_kwargs.copy()
    manager = ExperimentManager(
        agent_cls,
        (env_ctor, env_kwargs),
        fit_budget=T,
        n_fit=n_fit,
        agent_name=name,
        init_kwargs=agent_kwargs,
        wrappers=[(WriterWrapper, {})],
        parallelization="none",
        seed=42
    )
    managers.append(manager)

# Fit all agents
for manager in managers:
    manager.fit()

# Collect results
results = {}
for manager in managers:
    writer_data = manager.get_writer_data()
    actions = np.array(writer_data["action"])
    rewards = np.array(writer_data["reward"])
    # Compute cumulative reward
    cum_rewards = np.cumsum(rewards)
    # Compute cumulative regret
    optimal_mean = np.max(means)
    cum_regret = np.cumsum(optimal_mean - rewards)
    # Compute cumulative pseudo-regret
    pulls = np.zeros(n_arms)
    pseudo_regret = []
    for a in actions:
        pulls[a] += 1
        pseudo_regret.append(np.sum((optimal_mean - np.array(means)) * pulls))
    pseudo_regret = np.array(pseudo_regret)
    # Store results
    results[manager.agent_name] = {
        "actions": actions,
        "rewards": rewards,
        "cum_rewards": cum_rewards,
        "cum_regret": cum_regret,
        "cum_pseudo_regret": pseudo_regret,
        "pulls": pulls.copy()
    }

# Plotting styles
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
colors = sns.color_palette("tab10", n_colors=len(agent_classes))
linestyles = ['-', '--', '-.', ':', (0, (3, 1, 1, 1)), (0, (5, 1)), (0, (1, 1))]

# Plot cumulative pseudo-regret
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
for idx, (name, _) in enumerate(results.items()):
    plt.plot(
        results[name]["cum_pseudo_regret"],
        label=name,
        color=colors[idx],
        linestyle=linestyles[idx % len(linestyles)]
    )
plt.xlabel("Time step")
plt.ylabel("Cumulative Pseudo-Regret")
plt.title("Cumulative Pseudo-Regret of Bandit Agents")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Plot cumulative regret
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
for idx, (name, _) in enumerate(results.items()):
    plt.plot(
        results[name]["cum_regret"],
        label=name,
        color=colors[idx],
        linestyle=linestyles[idx % len(linestyles)]
    )
plt.xlabel("Time step")
plt.ylabel("Cumulative Regret")
plt.title("Cumulative Regret of Bandit Agents")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Plot number of times each arm was selected
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
bar_width = 0.1
indices = np.arange(n_arms)
for idx, (name, _) in enumerate(results.items()):
    plt.bar(
        indices + idx * bar_width,
        results[name]["pulls"],
        width=bar_width,
        label=name,
        color=colors[idx]
    )
plt.xlabel("Arm")
plt.ylabel("Number of Selections")
plt.title("Number of Times Each Arm Was Selected")
plt.xticks(indices + bar_width * (len(agent_classes) - 1) / 2, [f"Arm {i}" for i in range(n_arms)])
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
